states.owner_disposition: Require weld-class/NDE/acceptance/cryogenic qualification matrix; formal EQ/deviation for reduction.
Calibration evidence equivalence conditional on traceable certificates, integrity, loop checks and recalibration triggers.
Require clause-to-test WCS SAT crosswalk.
Commissioning evidence reuse only with controlled traceability and SAT integrated-mode proof.
Require scenario x transition x metric acceptance matrix.
Preserve minimum WCS equipment floor; require positive configuration evidence.
Preserve vibration acceptance; require equivalence/deviation substantiation and positive evidence.
Require quantified noise value, method, condition and acceptance evidence.
Freeze Owner compressor operating envelope and compare common evidence.
Preserve <=30% stable turndown; require compressor-map evidence.
Vendor oil-retention standard only if full contractual containment function/capacity demonstrated.
Require coupling equivalence against API 671 / ISO 10441 or retain baseline.
Preserve minimum QRB subsystem floor.
Preserve minimum cold-box component floor; alternatives require equivalence.
Require QRB/WCS interface matrix preserving sleeves, expansion, removability and VLP air-ingress objectives.
Preserve minimum WSH functional floor.
Preserve minimum WSH content/interface floor.
Prove warm-panel functional/interface equivalence or retain baseline.
Require failure-mode helium-preservation matrix.
Preserve <=1 Nm3/day criterion; require helium-loss budget and acceptance evidence.
Do not delete operational leak monitoring; standards substitution requires formal equivalence.
Preserve operational/standby leak-tightness qualification.
Bind VLP/LP/HP compression architecture and pressure-level evidence; LKT silence is not compliance.
Bind compressor count, stage allocation and identical-unit BOM/model evidence.
Resolve VFD applicability from canonical scope; bind full-load VFD rating to each applicable motor.
Require manufacturer EU 2019/1781 efficiency evidence.
Require <=100 ppm(w) guarantee, measurement method/location and FAT/SAT evidence; do not inherit unrelated family turndown deviation.
Bind QRB functional architecture, process-flow mapping and capacity evidence.
Require controlled cold-box layout/orientation tied to interfaces and maintainability.
Require inventory calculation, usable volume, pressure/temperature basis and margin.
Bind minimum three-vessel count, volume and arrangement.
Require vessel-by-vessel requirement/evidence matrix.
Bind required vessel instrumentation/equipment to tags and datasheets.
Bind WSH common equipment/functions to P&ID/BOM/control evidence.
Require WSH-WCS interface/control matrix for connection, isolation, transfer and recovery.
Bind final WSH layout to interfaces, access, maintainability and capacity.
Require traceable Cryogenic User inventory basis and margin; do not inherit unrelated leak-rate deviation.
Recover canonical Table 17 content and bidder-specific response; family deviation block is insufficient.
Preserve HP-LP and LP-VLP bypass functions and sizing; require topology/transient equivalence for alternatives.
Bind each required storage/header control valve to P&ID tag, Cv, fail position and control function.
ON/OFF isolation is not control-valve equivalence; require rangeability/transient proof or retain baseline.
Require reverse-flow/backspin/surge/transient protection per stage and equivalent automatic isolation if NRVs omitted.
Vendor implementation acceptable only if required purge/drain/rinse functions are preserved and evidenced.
